highlights.title: 5 comfortable bedrooms
highlights.text: 4 bedrooms with private bathrooms, including a ground-floor room accessible to guests with reduced mobility.

highlights.title: 7-seat hot tub
highlights.text: 104 jets, outdoors, available as an extra to unwind under the stars.

highlights.title: 1,500 m² walled garden
highlights.text: South-facing, with terrace, sun loungers, barbecue and a swing set for the children.

highlights.title: Private fishing pond
highlights.text: Carp, eels and roach just steps from the terrace — rod in hand, time stands still.

highlights.title: Fireplace & underfloor heating
highlights.text: Firewood provided for cool evenings, underfloor heating on the ground floor.

highlights.title: Every comfort
highlights.text: Free Wi-Fi, 107 cm TV, baby equipment, electric shutters, central vacuum.

home.regionText: Mont-Saint-Michel, the D-Day beaches and the loveliest villages of the Cotentin are all within easy driving distance.

teasers.title: D-Day beaches
teasers.text: The American Cemetery at Colleville, the Mulberry harbour at Arromanches.

teasers.title: Barfleur
teasers.text: One of the most beautiful villages in France, famous for its mussels.

spa.title: Your private hot tub, under the Normandy stars
spa.text: After a day on the beaches or at Mont-Saint-Michel, slip into the warm water of the 7-seat spa and let its 104 jets do the rest. Sheltered in its glass pavilion facing the garden, it is yours and your loved ones' alone for the whole stay.
spa.pricesTitle: Optional, depending on the length of your stay

gite.kitchenIntro: Everything you need to cook for a large group:

roomList.name: Sérénité bedroom
roomList.text: 1 bed 160×200. Shower room with a large hydromassage shower with built-in seat, washbasin, WC.

roomList.name: Bateau bedroom
roomList.text: 2 beds 90×190, 1 bunk bed 90×190, 1 pull-out bed 90×190. Bathroom with glass basin and hydromassage shower, WC.

roomList.name: Family bedroom
roomList.text: 1 bed 160×200. Forms a suite with the Cabine bedroom, sharing its bathroom and WC. Travel cot available for babies.

roomList.name: Cabine bedroom
roomList.text: 1 bunk bed 90×190 and 1 pull-out bed 90×190: the children's corner, right next to the Family bedroom.

roomList.name: La Marquise bedroom
roomList.text: 2 beds 90×200. Normandy-style wardrobe. Bathroom with glass basin, large hydromassage shower, WC.

jardins.gamesText: Slide, swings, trampoline and table tennis: plenty to keep the youngest (and the not so young) busy in the safe, walled garden.
jardins.bikersText: We also welcome motorcyclists, on request to the owners and under specific conditions.
jardins.ridersText: Bring your horses: up to 5 or 6 horses grazing together in the paddock, for {{price}} per horse per day, under their owners' responsibility.

tarifs.title: Rates & conditions
tarifs.otherDates: For other arrival days, please contact us.
tarifs.spaText: The 7-seat hot tub and its 104 jets, all to yourselves, to book with your stay.
tarifs.askText: Tell us your dates and the number of guests — Loïc and Maryline will reply personally.

region.see: Things to see in the Cotentin

sights.title: Barneville-Carteret
sights.text: A seaside resort popular with sailors.

sights.title: Cherbourg
sights.text: The "Port of the Americas", the Cité de la Mer and its nuclear submarine.

sights.title: Barfleur
sights.text: Listed among the "most beautiful villages of France", famous for its blonde mussels.

sights.title: Gatteville lighthouse
sights.text: The second tallest lighthouse in France.

sights.title: Vauban towers
sights.text: Listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

sights.title: Saint-Vaast-la-Hougue
sights.text: Taste the local oysters right on the harbour.

memoryList.title: D-Day beaches
memoryList.text: The American Cemetery at Colleville, the Mulberry harbour at Arromanches, the Caen Memorial.

memoryList.title: Sainte-Mère-Église
memoryList.text: Famous for the paratrooper hanging from its church tower.

memoryList.title: Bayeux Tapestry
memoryList.text: The 11th-century embroidery not to be missed.

malo.title: Saint-Malo
malo.text: The walled corsair city in Brittany.

region.mapText: The places to visit around the manor, gathered by Loïc and Maryline on an interactive map.
region.mapNotice: The map is hosted by Google Maps, which only loads it if you click.

activityList.title: Sailing & windsurfing
activityList.text: Sailing school and watersports club in Barneville-Carteret (dinghy, catamaran, windsurf).

activityList.title: Hiking & mountain biking
activityList.text: Trails around the Lande de Lessay heathland.

activityList.title: Cycling & land yachting
activityList.text: Bike hire, land yachting at Bretteville-sur-Ay.

activityList.title: Cotentin & Bessin nature park
activityList.text: Protected landscapes of marshland and hedgerows.

activityList.title: Champrepus zoo
activityList.text: A family day out less than an hour away.
